title: Security risk: prompt injection / data exfiltration
recommendation: Harden system prompt, add output filtering, extend the red-team suite, block deployment until PASS.

title: Fairness risk: group disparity in outcomes
recommendation: Apply mitigation (group thresholds or reweighting), re-test DI, document business acceptance criteria.

title: Explainability risk: insufficient citations
recommendation: Enforce citations per sentence or refuse policy answers without citations; re-evaluate coverage.

title: Hallucination risk: low grounding in retrieved context
recommendation: Tighten the prompt, raise retrieval quality, add an LLM-as-judge faithfulness check.
